collection.name: Get Topics (Page 1)
collection.comment: We need to make an API Call to get the initial topics and the total number of pages that we can navigate through. This is important since we use this information on the Screen Repeat settings to know how many times we can loop. Each loop allows us to query the next page topics as soon as we run out of topics. This event strictly requests the first page topics and is fired once. Follow-up topics of the next pages are queried separately on the screen display since we then have access to the nextPageUrl variable.
